-------
Coram :Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sujit Narayan Prasad

For the Petitioner : Mr. Pankaj Kumar, Advocate Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate For the Respondents
: Mr. Om Prakash Tiwari, Gp Iii Mr. Arun Kumar Dubey, Ac to Gp Iii
--------
th Order No. 09 : Dated 10 May, 2024
1.
Reference may be made to order dated 26th April, 2024.

2. In pursuance thereto, affidavit has been filed by the respondents-State stating inter alia that amount of compensation to the tune of Rs. 3,14,000 and odd has been assessed for the land in question to be paid in favour of petitioner.

3. Upon this, Mr. Pankaj Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the said amount cannot be said to be true compliance of the decree passed by the competent Court of civil jurisdiction, which is the subject matter of Execution Case No. 8 of 2008.

4. It has further been submitted that even the said amount cannot be said to be adequate compensation reason being that whatever assessment has been made that is based upon the rate prevailing in the year 1998 and herein as per Act, 2013 the compensation is required to be paid.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner in course of argument has submitted that if he will be adequately compensated he will make appropriate application before the executing Court on the basis of aforesaid settlement reason being that now the aforesaid property cannot be utilized for the Anirudh Prasad Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71548291/
1 purpose of farming since there is concrete structure and that is the reason alternative prayer has been made herein but the fact remains, as per learned counsel for the petitioner that without taking recourse of acquisition mechanism land has been utilized for construction of police station.
6.

sentences.text: Upon this, learned counsel for the State has sought for adjournment to settle the dispute so far quantum of compensation is concerned.
7. This Court considering the submissions advanced on behalf of parties is adjourning this matter again.
8. In pursuance to order dated 26.04.2024, explanation has been furnished by the Court concerned.
9. Let it be kept with the record.
Appropriate order shall be passed on the said explanation on the next date of hearing.

10. List this matter on 17.05.2024.
(Sujit Narayan Prasad, J.) Alankar/-
